title: Matt LaFleur defends Josh Jacobs: "I know the character of the guy"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Matt LaFleur defends Josh Jacobs: "I know the character of the guy"
sources.description: Packers running back Josh Jacobs will miss the first game of the season, and likely at least five more, after pleading no contest to misdemeanor charges of battery and criminal damage to property.
